title: Andragogical Inclusion: A Professional Knowledge Exchange

slides.title: Andragogical Inclusion: Title & Framing
slides.speakerNotes: Welcome colleagues. Emphasise that this room holds decades of front-line pedagogical wisdom. We are not delivering a deficit-model training session; we are interrogating institutional assumptions together to elevate learning for every adult.

slides.title: Knowles’ Andragogy Meets Critical Equity
slides.speakerNotes: Knowles assumed an unencumbered, autonomous adult. In reality, mature students carry socioeconomic precarity, systemic microaggressions, or past academic scarring. We must design psychological safety intentionally.

slides.title: The Inclusion Marketplace: 5 Adult Learning Barriers
slides.speakerNotes: Frame these not as student deficits, but as structural interfaces. Every barrier represents an institutional design friction that thoughtful pedagogy can alleviate.

slides.title: Marketplace Task: Friction vs. Inclusive Flow
slides.speakerNotes: Encourage radical candour. Green notes celebrate practical frontline genius; Amber notes pinpoint where university policies or assumptions create unnecessary roadblocks.

slides.title: Applied Case Studies: Choose Your Analytical Lens
slides.speakerNotes: Choice in professional development mirrors choice in adult learning. Give participants autonomy to select the challenge that directly stretches their domain expertise.

slides.title: Case Study A: Psychological Safety in Clinical Audiology
slides.speakerNotes: Provocation: How do we move from compliance-based classroom management to professional self-regulation in high-stakes practicals?

slides.title: Case Study B: Workload-Sustainable HyFlex Equity in Health
slides.speakerNotes: Provocation: How can we offer genuine temporal flexibility without creating unsustainable 60-hour working weeks for faculty?

slides.title: Case Study C: Multiple Means of Expression in Level 5 Coaching
slides.speakerNotes: Provocation: Does academic rigour live in the 3,000-word written essay, or does it live in the depth of critical evaluation demonstrated?

slides.title: Next Week's Redesign: Differentiated Action Brief
slides.speakerNotes: No one leaves with abstract theory. This slide bridges professional dialogue into immediate classroom operational change.

slides.title: Redesign Protocols: Developing vs. Stretching Practice
slides.speakerNotes: Highlight that experienced teachers need space to wrestle with complex edge cases, while newer colleagues benefit from immediate, high-leverage procedural templates.

slides.title: Plenary Choice Board: Choose Your Exit Commitment
slides.speakerNotes: Thank colleagues for their vulnerability and expertise. Remind everyone that inclusive andragogy is not an endpoint or checklist—it is an ongoing scholarly discipline practiced in community.
